speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: I have postponed this Parliamentary Question (PQ) three times since July this year and for the past three months, inflation rate has been gaining momentum and breaking records month after month.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: It is now 5.1% in August, the highest in 14 years.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: We understand that Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong has repeatedly said that the Government is prepared to do more if the inflation is persistently high.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: I think the Senior Minister of State will agree that households with a bigger number of people face more challenging headwinds in this high inflation environment compared to households with lesser members.

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: So, would the Government consider giving more CDC vouchers to bigger households as compared to smaller households?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: Also, the second part of my question is, will the Government consider giving the CDC Vouchers to individual Singaporeans, rather than one per household?

speaker: Mr Ang Wei Neng (West Coast)
text: And lastly, what else will the Government consider doing, given that inflation has been consistent for the past few months since the last announcement by Deputy Prime Minister Lawrence Wong in May to give more help to Singaporeans?

speaker: Mr Speaker
text: Please do keep your supplementary questions short and not inflate it.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: So, some of these measures are still being implemented, are still being rolled out.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: But as I mentioned in my reply, we are closely monitoring the situation and if it is necessary for us to provide more support, we are prepared to do so.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: Besides CDC Vouchers, there are also many other schemes to help Singaporeans to cushion the impact of rising prices, such as additional U-Save rebates and Household Utilities Credit.

speaker: Mr Chee Hong Tat
text: But at the same time, we do have broad-based schemes, like CDC Vouchers and Household Utilities Credits, which we will give to all households to provide some help, to help them to cushion the impact of high inflation.
